===================================================================
--- cmd/dump/main.go	
+++ cmd/dump/main.go	
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"github.com/davecgh/go-spew/spew"
+
+	"debugtool/inspect"
+)
+
+type Server struct {
+	Name     string
+	Port     int
+	Tags     []string
+	Labels   map[string]any
+	peers    map[*Server]bool
+	Callback func(int) error
+}
+
+func main() {
+	primary := &Server{
+		Name: "primary",
+		Port: 8080,
+		Tags: []string{"prod", "api"},
+		Labels: map[string]any{
+			"region": "us-east-1",
+			"zone":   3,
+		},
+	}
+
+	replica := &Server{
+		Name:   "replica",
+		Port:   8081,
+		Tags:   []string{"prod", "replica"},
+		Labels: map[string]any{"region": "us-west-2"},
+	}
+
+	primary.peers = map[*Server]bool{replica: true}
+	replica.peers = map[*Server]bool{primary: true}
+
+	inspect.Dump(primary)
+
+	spew.Config = inspect.Config
+	spew.Printf("config: %#v\n", primary.Labels)
+}

--- inspect/inspect.go	
+++ inspect/inspect.go	
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+package inspect
+
+import (
+	"io"
+
+	"github.com/davecgh/go-spew/spew"
+)
+
+var Config = spew.ConfigState{
+	Indent:                  "    ",
+	SortKeys:                true,
+	DisableMethods:          true,
+	DisablePointerMethods:   true,
+	DisablePointerAddresses: true,
+	DisableCapacities:       true,
+}
+
+func Sdump(values ...any) string {
+	if len(values) == 1 {
+		return Config.Sdump(values[0])
+	}
+	return Config.Sdump(values)
+}
+
+func Dump(values ...any) {
+	Config.Dump(values...)
+}
+
+func Fdump(w io.Writer, values ...any) {
+	Config.Fdump(w, values...)
+}
